notes.title: Alpha Build 0.8
notes.content:
[h2]Artwork Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] All buildings, except the Averagerator got a full makeover.
[*] General Tile detail window is now much smaller and displays a bit more information about the tile. Right click on any unoccupied tile to open this window.
[/list]

[h2]Building Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Fields are now constructed through the Farm GUI and can be placed on any tile owned by your faction.
[*]  Crops can only be planted in a field by an assigned Farmer through the Farm GUI
[*]  Wood Planks, Wood Blocks, Stone Blocks, Stone Slabs, Stone HandAxe, and Stone PickAxe recipes have been added to the Workshop
[*]  All Steel and Iron weapon recipes have been removed from the workshop and are now only at the blacksmith
[*]  Mines can now only be placed on a Stone or Ore resource node.
[/list]

[h2]Misc Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Press "L" to toggle Faction Control display.  All tiles owned by your faction will light up in green.
[*]  Hovering your mouse over a characters tile will now display its name and vital stats.
[*]  Selection highlighting changed to be more obvious which tile was selected and its relationship to your faction
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Build 0.7
notes.content:
[b]Added Inventory and Item functionality[/b]
[list]
[*]Item stacks can now be broken up in your inventory
[*]Partial stacks can now be transferred between characters and buildings
[*]Items can now be transferred between characters (left click to open trade window)
[*]Items can now be destroyed in your inventory
[/list]

[b]New Building - The Averagerator[/b]
[list]
[*] This new building blueprint will be available in the workshop and is a useful tool for cleaning up small stacks of unused resources.
[*] The Averagerator will take your mismatched qualities of the same resource and return a single stack of the average quality.
[*]Due to this being a messy process,  some of your resources will be lost and you will be returned 10% - 90% of the amount of resource put in depending on the quality of your Averagerator.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Save system has been updated to handle the new formats and information
[*] Save/Load system has been re-enabled.  Any existing saves SHOULD BE DELETED as they will no longer load correctly if at all.
[*] Several buildings that didn't get updated to the new GUI system have now been updated and should no longer give issues interacting with them.
[*] Blueprint: Field has been re-added to the list of recipes available in the workshop
[*] Characters can no longer build a Workshop at the start of the game.
[*] Remote dismissing a working through the Town Center will now update the building the building the worker was dismissed from properly.
[*] Learned recipe display will now show the correct learned recipe.
[*] Lost copper nodes re-added to the game.
[*] Fixed GUI display issues.
[*] Tool-tips for generic location information updated.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Build 0.6
notes.content:
* Changed Basic HUD
	- Added Strenth, Agility, and Intelligence levels to the left side indicated by icons.
	- Changed Health, Stamina, Mana to icons instead of text
	- Changed buttons to Inventory, Skills, and Construction

* Removed Character window as most of the information was already displayed in more logical locations

* Added construction menu
[list]
[*] 	- Changed blueprints to teach a new construction recipe rather than using them to place buildings.
[*] 	- Character starts with the recipes for a Workbench and a Town Center
[*] 	- Upon creation of the Town Center and initializing your new colony, you will be granted the basic gathering point recipes
[*]  	        - Lumber Yard
[*] 		- Mine
[*] 		- Farm
[*] 		- Storage
[*] 	- Can hotkey recipes while in construction menu simply by pressing the number of the hotkey you want to store it in.
[*] 		-Note: Clicking on the hotkey in the construction window will clear whats there
[/list]

* Rebuilt the skill window and it now breaks the skills down into categories for easier searching
	- Active and Magic Skills can be hotkeyed by pressing the number of the hotkey you wish to store it in
	- A skill that can be hotkeyed will have a large "H" in the top right corner of the description panel

* Removed crafting without a building and moved most of the recipes that could be crafted into a workbench structure.
	- Every character knows how to build a workbench and costs very little raw resources to create
	- Workbenches do not add to your factions territory scores

* Added a Colony creation system.
	- Upon completion of your town center, you will be prompted to enter a Colony name.  This will register the colony to your faction and most of your colony management and information can be viewed or changed at the Town Center by your faction commander.
	- All buildings (except the workbench) built from here will be registered with your faction and add to your factions controlled area and control strength granting bonuses to certain actions performed within your factions territory

*Town Center updates
	- Displays a list of all faction characters.  Clicking on one will open up some more details about the character
	- Change name of your characters
	- The faction commander can dismiss any characters that have been assigned to a task from here.  This will generally result in the dismissed character returning to the players direct control until assigned a different task.
	- View a list of structures owned by your faction (more info with destruction options coming in next patch)

* Removed the upgrade system and made each upgrade structure its own structure that can be built on its own

* Resource Point buildings (Lumber Yard, Mine, Farm) are drop points for the buildings resource and must be built to automate resource gathering.
	- A number of characters can join the buildings workforce and become automated harvesters.  A dropdown of all the valid resouces allows the selection of the desired resource.
	- A hired character can be dismissed by the Faction Commander either at the specific building or by going to the Town Center


* Moved Attack and Defense attributes to skills and start them at 1 like every other skill.  You can track their progress on the skill menu

* Added lots of tool tips to help with GUI navigation

* Characters now have a carry limit that is 10x their current strength.  Going over this limit will not freeze the character in place, it will instead gradually add movement penalties to the character until eventually it costs more stamina to move than the character has and preventing them from moving further.  (Next patch will have the option to drop or destroy items to help when stuck away from someplace to offload properly)

* In SANDBOX MODE, once you have built your Town Center, up to 4 new citizens can be added to your colony at start of each day.

* Added  the HAULER vehicle.  This is a fully automated vehicle capable of carrying a large amount of weight.  It will automatically follow your main character around, but can be commanded to follow any character in your faction.  
     - Left-Click on the HAULER to bring up its control window.  From here you can change its follow target; selecting itself will cause it to remain in place until giving it a new target.  You can also deposit and withdraw items from the HAULER from this window.

* Reworked Manufacturing building GUI

* Can now join workforce as an individual citizen or hire a specific worker as the Faction Commander(Your main character)

* Updated Combat system to work with the new character state machine

* All existing skills should now be fully working.

* Note on buffs/debuffs:  You can apply multiple buffs of the same type to the same character, but only the highest buff will be counted.  If the new buff is the same or smaller than the existing buff, nothing will happen.

* Harvesting bugfixes

* Combat bugfixes

notes.title: HOTFIX 0.5.2.2
notes.content:
Fixed issue causing characters to not always despawn on death
Fixed issue causing despawned characters to not always despawning equipped gear
Fixed issue causing character to stand back up after being rendered unconscious
Fixed issue causing Endless Assault to save and Sandbox to not (they got flipped)
Fixed a typo causing many buffs/debuffs to not fire

notes.title: Update 0.5.2
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Massive construction cost rebalance.  
[*] Added Craft All and Craft Turn buttons to the crafting window.
[*] -Craft All will craft as many of the item as possible and wait further orders
[*] -Craft Turn will do the same as Craft All except automatically end your turn upon completion
[*] Added the active characters inventory to all building windows to make it easier to move items around without juggling multiple windows
[*] Merged the Equipment sheet into the inventory panel to again make it easier to mange your equipment
[*] Old equipment button will now open the character sheet
[*] Added several tool tips and help options
[*] Added Flanking -  A character is considered flanking if they are attacking their target from directly behind or one "side" to the left or right and can do up to double damage
[*] Added a short global cooldown to skills in combat to prevent skillspam
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing many different skills to put their experience gains in to blocking.
[*] Hopefully fixed a bug causing enemies to attack practically never
[*] Inventory now closes automatically when using a building blueprint
[*] Workers assigned to a task will have their worker window updated to reflect their current task properly
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5 Save Your Game
notes.content:
Additions
Added the ability to save and load your games.  This feature is only available in Sandbox mode (and the upcoming Campaign) and NOT for the Endless Assault Mode.
Saving occurs automatically at the end of every round.  In the future this will be adjustable to per turn/round/day/never autosave.

Added Two Game Modes: Endless Assault and Sandbox
Endless Assault:  You have given 7 other characters(plus you), a small fort, and a load of supplies.  You have one day to set up defenses before enemies spawn at midnight of every day and come for you. Slay as many as you can before being overrun.

Sandbox:  Build whatever you like without being harassed by enemies.

notes.title: Patch 0.4.4
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added several new graphics options to the options menu.
[*] Added auto detect for settings.
[*] Added save settings option to save all settings.
[*] Added a visible turn indicator over the character whose turn it currently is.
[*] Added a Build Turn button on the construction menu.  This will build out as many times a possible and either end your turn if the building isn't complete or wait for further instructions if it is.
[*] Added the resource quality system.  Higher quality resources create better items and structures.
[*] Added: Iron and Steel Kettle Helms
[*] Fully Added Heal, Fireball, and Lightning spells.
[*] Added Iceball spell.
[*] Fireball can set your target on fire once they have accumulated enough fire damage.  This can be put out by the character by attempting to douse it or by using a spell such as iceball on them.  Fire is capable of spreading to nearby characters or tiles if it gets out of hand.
[*] Iceball can freeze your target in place.  The frozen character will need to attempt use strength to break free of the ice or stay frozen until thawed.  Get a tile cold enough and it too will freeze.
[*] A massive amount of update Icon art.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the building system causing the wrong items to be used when calculating the buildings final quality
[*] Fixed character rotation using A/D to rotate left right.
[*] Combat window should now close properly when ending your turn.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.4.3
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New "final" terrain for the world.  It will of course receive several artwork and detail passes but the general layout for the starting area is now complete.
[*] Two new tree types
[*] Significantly larger world(went from ~10k navigation points to ~40k)
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing the camera to not set itself correctly when changing characters.
[/list]

Notes:
While there isn't a long list of changes with this patch, a lot of changes and optimizations have happened in the back-end in preparations for the upcoming Demo release.   Would love to get some feedback on overall performance and any janky areas of the map you come across.   As long as all goes well, we will release more navigable map space in the coming days along with the tutorial system and Chapter I of the campaign for testing and ironing out before the Demo and Next Fest.

Thank you all for your help so far!

[h2]Additions[/h2]

[*] New Upgrades: Storage, Forge, Sawmill, Granary, Field
[*] New Building: Farm
[*] New Items: Iron Sword, Iron Spear, Iron Long Spear, Iron Axe, Iron Great Sword, Iron Dagger, Iron Blade, Iron Large Blade, Iron Axe Head, Iron Spear Head, Steel Blade, Steel Large Blade, Steel Axe Head, Steel Spear Head, Wooden Handle, Wooden 2H Handle, Fruit Snack, Flour Sack, Cornmeal Sack, Potato Sack, Wheat Bushel, Corn Bushel, Corn Seed, Seed Potato, Wheat Seed, Large Saw blade

notes.title: Patch 0.4.1
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Tile: Coal
[*] New Resource: Coal
[*] New Skills: Metallurgy, Cooking, Mansonry, Woodworking, and Leatherworking
[*] New Recipes: Iron Ingot, Steel Ingot - These can be made in the Workshop after building at least one smelter upgrade. 
[*] New Upgrade: Smelter - The smelter can built as an upgrade to the workshop and can be built as many times as there are open tiles around the workshop.
[*] Automation - You can now use your main character, or faction commander, to manage automation for your Workshop(soon every building).  By hiring a faction member,  you can assign them to automatically manufacture a specified item on their turn.  There are currently no notifications for when they run out of resources so they will need to be restocked often to keep them productive.  This will change in the next update.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Quit Game Prompt - Hitting ESC now prompts you to quit or cancel
[*] 
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]

[*] Constructing buildings is working again.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.0
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] After Selecting your character you will now choose your own location to spawn.
[*] You now have up to 3 Civilians who spawn with you under your direct control.
[*] Sound effects to most gathering actions
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed out from the hexagon built world to a true Landscape system
[*] Pine tree graphical update
[*] All aggressive characters are gone for now
[*] Starting inventory adjusted to be more inline with the tutorial that is coming soon.
[*] You now start with Town Center and a Workshop blueprints.  From the workshop you can use paper to create the blueprints for the other buildings as well as walls and gates to surround your "town". 
[*] Blueprints will now disappear after use. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Characters now look at the resource they are gathering.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES v0.3.7
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Weapon: 1 Handed Spear
[*] New Weapon: 2 Handed Spear
[*] New Weapon: Dagger
[*] New Weapon: Greatsword
[*] New Skill: Chop - Costly but devastating heavy weapon strike
[*] New Skill: Jab - Cheap low damage skill that will help finish off opponents
[*] New Skill: Swipe - Cheap low damage skill for spears
[*] New Tile: Water Tile - 20 Stamina to move onto.  Contains fish and water resources(cant yet pull either, coming in v0.4 World Building)
[*] Food System Added: Vitals are no longer replenished at the start of each turn for free.  You must equip food items to be used to refill you at the start of your turn.  Different foods will have different replenishment values but if you have no food at all it will start to take from your health at a rate of 1HP per 20 Stamina and 10 mana so be sure to watch your food supplies.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Attacks that had no reason to do mana damage should no longer do mana damage.
[*] Switching combat targets while already engaged with another character will no longer switch your character into unarmed combat mode
[*] Chaining together skills too quickly should no longer crash out the skills
[*] Fixed the massive delay when changing to peace mode from combat mode when unarmed before you can move.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.3.6
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Combat backend refactor :  Combat calculations much more performant and more dynamic to allow for greater interaction between combatants
[*] Equipment panel now shows  amount of ammo equipped
[/list]

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added new indicator on a tile to highlight selected character.  Faction friendly will show green and non-faction will show red.
[*]Added feedback for not enough mana or health to perform an action
[*]Added feedback for hotkeying a skill
[*]Added clamps on the camera to disallow it from going under the player or too far away
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
Magic based attacks now give intelligence XP instead of agility
Heal Skill icon returned
Vital HUD now updates when attacked
Unequipping ammo no longer unequips the weapon
Unequipping a ranged weapon now unequips the associated ammo
Spawned ammo holders now despawn when the associated weapon is unequipped
Starting a turn will now return the correct amount of lost stamina and mana
Combat window should now close when another tile is selected to move to
Character now looks at the new target if already in combat with one enemy and a new one is chosen
NPC attacks no longer always do maximum possible damage on hit
Arrows now actually do and display damage on hit
